name: after-20-answering-mark
pre: (async () => { const d=document.documentElement; d.classList.remove('dark'); d.style.colorScheme='light'; try{localStorage.removeItem('sx:kb_sources')}catch(e){} const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const row=document.querySelector('[data-design-focus="knowledge-sources"]'); [...row.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Add knowledge base').click(); await sleep(900); const dlg=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot="sheet-content"][data-state="open"]')].pop(); for(const sw of dlg.querySelectorAll('button[role="switch"]')){ if(sw.getAttribute('aria-checked')==='true'){ sw.click(); await sleep(250); } } for(const lb of ['Attach Compliance Laws v2','Attach Data Protection Guidelines']){ const sw=dlg.querySelector('button[role="switch"][aria-label="'+lb+'"]'); if(sw&&sw.getAttribute('aria-checked')!=='true'){ sw.click(); await sleep(300); } } [...dlg.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Save').click(); await sleep(1200); const r2=document.querySelector('[data-design-focus="knowledge-sources"]'); r2.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); await sleep(400); document.querySelectorAll('#wz-5-kb').forEach(e=>{ if(e.getBoundingClientRect().height===0) e.remove() }); return document.querySelector('#wz-5-kb').innerText.replace(/\n+/g,' | '); })()

marks.name: Answering · Attached, not read
marks.why: Attach takes a list of bases and the engine payload carries one kb_id, so a second base rendered identically and was never read. The row names the inert one rather than letting it pass as live.

name: after-20-sources-in-a-base
pre: (async () => { const d=document.documentElement; d.classList.remove('dark'); d.style.colorScheme='light'; const day=86400000, now=Date.now(); try{localStorage.setItem('sx:kb_sources', JSON.stringify([{id:'src_seed_site',kbId:'kb_01',kind:'site',label:'docs.example.com',address:'https://docs.example.com',pages:211,state:'active',addedAt:now-30*day,lastReadAt:now-4*day,autoRefresh:true}]))}catch(e){} const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const pd=(el)=>{const o={bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,pointerId:1,pointerType:'mouse',isPrimary:true};el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',o));el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',o));el.click()}; const row=document.querySelector('[data-design-focus="knowledge-sources"]'); [...row.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Add knowledge base').click(); await sleep(900); pd(document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Compliance Laws v2 options"]')); await sleep(700); pd([...document.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitem"]')].find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==='Open sources')); await sleep(1400); const sh=document.querySelector('[data-slot="sheet-content"][data-state="open"]'); return sh?sh.innerText.replace(/\n+/g,' | '):'NO SHEET'; })()

marks.name: Sources inside one base
marks.why: A base is a container, not a fifth kind of connector: an upload and a crawled site sit in the same base, and the read date rides the source because freshness is a property of a source and never of the base.

name: after-20-crawl-ledger
pre: (async () => { const d=document.documentElement; d.classList.remove('dark'); d.style.colorScheme='light'; const day=86400000, now=Date.now(); try{localStorage.setItem('sx:kb_sources', JSON.stringify([{id:'src_seed_site',kbId:'kb_01',kind:'site',label:'docs.example.com',address:'https://docs.example.com',pages:211,state:'active',addedAt:now-30*day,lastReadAt:now-4*day,autoRefresh:true}]))}catch(e){} const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const pd=(el)=>{const o={bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,pointerId:1,pointerType:'mouse',isPrimary:true};el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',o));el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',o));el.click()}; const row=document.querySelector('[data-design-focus="knowledge-sources"]'); [...row.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Add knowledge base').click(); await sleep(900); pd(document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Compliance Laws v2 options"]')); await sleep(700); pd([...document.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitem"]')].find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==='Open sources')); await sleep(1200); const sh=document.querySelector('[data-slot="sheet-content"][data-state="open"]'); [...sh.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Crawl a site').click(); await sleep(700); const inp=document.getElementById('crawl-address-kb_01'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(inp,'https://docs.acme.com'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await sleep(500); [...sh.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Start crawl').click(); await sleep(3000); const led=[...sh.querySelectorAll('div')].find(e=>/^Pages found/.test(e.innerText||'')); if(led) led.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); await sleep(400); return sh.innerText.replace(/\n+/g,' | '); })()

marks.name: The page ledger a crawl owes back
marks.why: A crawl used to mint 210 chunks whether or not it read anything. Kept, skipped and failed are counted with a reason per page, so the pages that did not make it are named where the crawl ran.
